Okay, I've updated the code - no idea how it got cut off. I definitely get output, now. But the code does not identify any target regions. The idea is it looks for area of contiguous pixels (that aren't text), and outputs a crop to that region. A slight difficulty is that images are sometimes in discrete pieces that should still be treated as one image (a pair of pointing hands, for example). With the complete code, an output is as follows:

✗ python extract_woodcuts_v2.py ../samples/ACuriousHieroglyphickBible105.jpg --no-merge --debug
